notes.title: Prelude Update 0.9.6
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,  

Thank you so much for your feedback and we're thrilled with how much everyone's enjoying the Prelude! Please keep the feedback coming as it helps make a better game. Please be sure to share any bugs you encounter on the Steam forums, below, or in the discord! 



FIXES

Fixed Tomes not being able to block

 Fixed Steal no longer working on all monsters after 10 Stealing Attempts during the same run

 Fixed being able to get dungeon completion achievements when running away before the boss fight

(JAPANESE) Fixed "Current Floor" counter and other text displays

Fixed the dice button at the bottom left of the Edit Character menu being able to change your race and reset your character back to level 1

 Fixed your name being set to "Hero" if you didnt input or randomize your name atleast once



CHANGES

Changed sound effects of Axe Abilities "Hungry Chop" and "Hack And Slash"

Auto Save Message now appears in the proper Language you choose, or in your device's language

Publisher and Developer logo sounds now honor your Audio settings

Monster's Crit Chance stats are no longer affected by the Monster Strength setting

Encounter Rate and Treasure Floor dungeon upgrades can no longer be chosen in Boss Dungeons, if youve already added points into those upgrades, consider Resetting to get your points back

Can now see your current skill level in Ability Tooltips

(ANDROID ONLY) Hid some unrelated options such as Fullscreen mode and Cursor settings



MORE FIXES TO COME



A non-steam version and an Android version can be downloaded on itch.io: https://renoki.itch.io/dragaea-idle



Be sure to wishlist the main game and share the game with your friends, every little bit helps us out a ton!



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3730300/Legends_of_Dragaea_Idle_Dungeons_Prelude/"][/dynamiclink]

Until next time!

notes.title: August Dev Update - Unique Legendaries
notes.notes:

notes.title: July Dev Update
notes.notes:
Hey All, 

Just wanted to say thanks a ton for the recent attention on the game!

Dragaea got a ton of wishlists over the course of this month and its really nice to see. Hello new players!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960178/2ab8c81fa5e5ed8e0c5b54dc2955f7536f1030f8.png"]

I've been taking down a lot of notes and fixed a lot based on your feedback, so please keep them coming.

As for how the game is doing, I'm actually 90% done the game now. All the dungeons and Monsters are complete but I just need to finish off the Postgame Dungeon, extra Quality of Life features, and add in the rest of the Quests and Abilities before I can call the game finished.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960178/f52e3b5b2485ebfe95749dd315b6be4e7093a90c.png"]

I plan on releasing a follow up Demo by end of August or September, so hang tight. This demo will have a bit more to offer than the current demo, besides a ton of fixes and QoL, I'll also have a Gambling shop (similar to Diablo 2), Achievements, a better Wear Best feature, Unique Legendaries, and a balance overhaul (sorry White Magic players). 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960178/942282db7775ca2dda0c23560e3fbe1da30966a3.png"]These icons and achievements aren't final



If you've read this far we have some sneak peeks of the Gambling Shop, and some of the later dungeons you'll be encountering in the full game.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960178/a7b321837a62614c82b2e94141d7d31546f533e0.png"]Roll the dice on mystery equipment


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960178/6e29e23eee063573aabaf33da129c9e3356890a8.png"]Explore the dangerous Latia Jungles



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960178/f10a60caf117171abb06e9551fde23d7ba0c35a4.png"]Go spelunking in the Ilia Caverns


Please be sure to wishlist the game and the upcoming prelude if you haven't already and post any feedback you have as it really helps us with the game!  

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3730300/Legends_of_Dragaea_Idle_Dungeons_Prelude/?"][/dynamiclink]
Thanks again for reading and chat with you all soon!

notes.title: Spring Demo Update Patch #6
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Please keep the feedback coming as it helps make a better game. Here's Spring Demo patch update #6. Please be sure to share any bugs you encounter on the Steam forums, below, or in the discord!


CHANGES

 Added tooltips to items, abilities, and perks when you hover your mouse over their buttons. You can even examine enemy abilities during combat if you hover your mouse over their abilities. (pc version only)
 added volume sliders for music and sound effects.
 Hype Up, the Waykin's racial ability, now gives White Magic exp on use.
 Added links to Steam, Itch.io and Discord on the main menu screen.



FIXES

 Fixed the cooldowns of utility items (before they would ready themselves instantly)
 Fixed being able to use the same utility item loadout twice during a boss dungeon


Be sure to wishlist and share the game with your friends, every little bit helps us make a better game.

notes.title: Spring Demo Update Patch #5
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Please keep the feedback coming as it helps make a better game. Here's Spring Demo patch update #5. Please be sure to share any bugs you encounter on the Steam forums, below, or in the discord!


CHANGES

 Advantage Encounters now have a different song.
 Decreased the Security Chance bonus of the Security Prowess perk to 0.5% per level from 1% per level.
 Equipment, Abilities and Perks buttons in the stats menu now only appear if you upgrades your buildings enough.
 Agility can no longer go below 1, At 0 or below, enemies would stop targeting you because of a divide by 0 error.
 Added +5 points buttons to the Dungeon Upgrade menu



FIXES

 Fixed the Sense Prowess perk giving you 20% Magic Find per level instead of the correct amount. (now 0.25% per level)
 Fixed the Axe Prowess perk giving you 25% Melee Speed Bonus per level instead of the correct amount. (now 0.25% per level)
 Fixed the Black Magic Prowess perk giving you 20% Magic Crit Chance per level instead of the correct amount. (now 0.2% per level)
 Fixed the Block Prowess perk giving you 25% Physical Block Chance and Magical Block Chance per level instead of the correct amount. (now 0.25% per level)
 Fixed the Item Lore Prowess perk giving you 100% Item Mastery per level instead of the correct amount. (now 1% per level)
 Fixed the Katana Prowess perk giving you 20% Melee Crit Chance per level instead of the correct amount. (now 0.2% per level)
 Fixed the White Magic Prowess perk giving you 25% Magic Speed Bonus per level instead of the correct amount. (now 0.25% per level)
 Fixed not properly updating stats of all characters after purchasing guild upgrades or after resetting the guild upgrade board
 Fixed the Barrier Charged perk's Max Barrier to Magic Power calculation (before it multiplied by your max barrier instead of giving you 25% of it)
 Fixed quantity panel appearing in the dungeon results screen when you look at a material item.
 Fixed Crystalized Azure Mana, Crystalized Crimson Mana, and Crystalized Gold Mana not transferring to your inventory when dropped from the Dark Elf Griffon boss. These crystals upgrade your utility items, capes and rings respectively.
 Fixed 9-man party expeditions not working properly, before it would only send the first 3 characters, leaving the other 6 adventurers behind.
 Fixed the descriptions of some perks.
 Fixed some spelling mistakes. (I swear English is my first language)


Be sure to wishlist and share the game with your friends, every little bit helps us make a better game.

notes.title: Spring Demo Update Patch #3
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Please keep the feedback coming as it helps make a better game. Here's Spring Demo patch update #3. Please be sure to share any bugs you encounter on the Steam forums, below, or in the discord!

CHANGES

 Fixed Life Bonus and Barrier Bonus not working
 Decreased Life Bonus, Barrier Bonus, Physical Block Chance, and Magical Block Chance rolls on equipment
 Hidden Stock Training guild upgrade now restocks the town when purchased
 Hidden Stock Training guild upgrade now multiplies the stack size of materials sold at the Labourer's Union by the amount of points put into the guild upgrade + 1
 Increased the base stack size of all materials sold at the Labourer's Union from 5 to 10
 Fixed the Refreshing Escape perk healing the enemy instead of you whenever you dodged
 Fixed Hidden Stock Training guild upgrade duplicating equip items instead of stocking the shops with new equip items
 Fixed basic Attack ability not being translated properly
 Fixed constantly using Restoration and Rejuvination potions if you have someone in your party with 0 max barrier
 Limited Imbue and Charge to 60 Ability Power (they can only charge abilities up to 60%, instead of 4930%)
 Limited Haste and Slow to 60% (no more hasting for 300%)
 Fixed Life and Barrier restoration calculations for Comforting Action, Barrier Builder and Life Builder perks
 Fixed Life and Barrier restoration calculations for Defensive Healing and Defensing Recharging perks 
 Fixed the Utility Equip menu showing a ghost of your two handed weapon if you have no utilities equipped
 Improved generation of Adventurers at the Tavern, they can now have favored skills they start with a high level
 Many minor fixes and adjustments


Be sure to wishlist and share the game with your friends, every little bit helps us make a better game.

notes.title: Spring Demo Update Patch #2
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Please keep the feedback coming as it helps make a better game. Here's the next Spring Demo patch update. Please be sure to share any bugs you encounter on the Steam forums, below, or in the discord!

CHANGES

 Fixed Weak status effect not displaying its description properly
 Fixed  Charge and Imbue having an incorrect scaling of x10, changed to x0.1 of your Magic Power instead
 Halved the Magic Power scaling of Heal
 Fixed  Iceblade and Fissure scaling from Melee Attack instead of Magic Power
 Damage dealt numbers now display up to 6 digits from 4
 Lowered the hiring cost of adventurers at the tavern
 You can now leave dungeons without losing items and dragnir
 You can now leave non-ambush battles, but you lose half of your obtained items and dragnir

 Woolkin's "Heavy Handed" perk now has a 10% chance to trigger, from 5%
 Woolkin's "Resilient" perk now has a 10% chance to trigger, from 1%
 Equipped items now display +1 if an equipment was upgraded with +1


Be sure to wishlist and share the game with your friends, every little bit helps us make a better game.

notes.title: Spring Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, we're pleased to announce we have a major update for the demo with a ton of overhauled and new systems including massive 9 member boss dungeons!

Check out the patch notes below and let us know what you think! If you have any bugs to report be sure to drop them below, in the Steam forums, or on discord! 

Happy dungeon crawling!


 9-man party Boss Dungeons
 Equip Upgrading, upgrade and craft equipment with the mods you want
 Town Building, upgrade buildings for better services
 Perks, level skills enough to unlock perks that can be equipped for further build variety
 Guild Upgrades, from completing quests, rank up and gain upgrade points that upgrade the stats of your adventurers.
 Expeditions, send parties out on adventures and gain loot even while the game is off.
 Bestiary, fill out a beastiary full of monsters to gain extra stat bonuses for your adventurers
 New Skills like Security and Sense
 Vastly Rebalanced everything

So please continue to leave your feedback in the forum and bugs in the thread, we're still reading and incorporating these changes. Thanks again!

Changes

Be sure to wishlist and share the game with your friends, every little bit helps us make a better game.

notes.title: Demo Update #4
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Please keep the feedback coming as it helps make a better game. Here's the fourth demo patch adding some more QoL changes and fixes. In case you missed it, the previous announcement has the links to the Android and non-Steam Windows version on our itch.

FIXES
- Fixed an issue when you tried to remove a character from your roster with at least 1 empty equip slot
- Fixed the description of the Kitkin race incorrectly stating that they're 3 meters tall when they're 3 feet tall (my bad, they're actually short and not tall chads)
- Reduced the default volume of some sound effects

BALANCING
- Reduced the requirements to speedup to Dungeon lv 5/10/20

ADDITIONS
- Added a sound when you hire a character at the tavern
- Added a sound when you equip an item
- Your inventory now auto sorts whenever you visit the equip menu or inventory menu

Be sure to wishlist and share the game with your friends, every little bit helps us make a better game.

notes.title: Demo Update #3
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Thank you so much for the reception to the game! We're thrilled so many people are enjoying it! Please keep the feedback coming as it helps make a better game. Here's the third demo patch adding some more QoL changes and fixes. 

FIXES
- Fixed tavern background noise playing even when the music audio was disabled.
- Fixed some inventory bugs where inventories wouldn't update properly (especially in the utility menu)
- Fixed equipping or selling resetting the inventory page back to 1, it now keeps the page you were on.
- Fixed character faces staying gray even after getting revived

ADDITIONS
- Added an autosave feature, every 5 minutes the game will auto save. This can be turned off in the Options Menu.
- Can now sell all by rarity in shops
- Can now sell items from the Storehouse

Be sure to wishlist and share the game with your friends, every little bit helps us make a better game.

notes.title: Demo Update #2
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

The amount of feedback and great ideas has been wonderful. Please keep them coming as it helps make a better game. Here's the second demo patch targeting some of those more edge case issues and adding some more QoL changes. 

Be sure to wishlist and share the game with your friends, every little bit helps us make a better game.

FIXES
- Fixed an issue where killing an enemy with thorns or reflect damage would softlock combat
- Fixed Options not saving between sessions

BALANCING
- Added a max level for all skills (100)
- Increased max Dragnir you can obtain to 99999999

ADDITIONS
- Added Party AI Setting in the Options Menu, this lets you decide how your party targets monsters in combat (Random, Lowest HP, Highest HP)
- Pressing Escape or Right Mouse button will bring you back a menu
- Shift + Clicking an item in a shop will sell it, also works while equipping. (if you meet the requirements to equip the item)
- Can now queue dungeons up to 50 times (let me know if this should be higher)

MORE TO COME

notes.title: Demo Update #1
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We love all the feedback you've given so far about the game and we're working hard to update the demo all the fixes you've mentioned! Here's the first patch for the demo and we're working hard on more fixes so keep those bug reports and feedback coming in! 

Be sure to wishlist and share the game with your friends, every little bit helps us make a better game.

FIXES
- Fixed damage bonuses applying twice
- Fixed a bug that caused combat to softlock when your entire party is wiped out
- Fixed a bug that caused combat to softlock when the enemy party is wiped out (may still happen, gonna look into it more)
- Fixed music turning back on after disabling music audio
- Fixed an issue where renaming a character deletes their equipment
- Fixed character editing menu not syncing with the character
- Fixed being able to get an Encounter while interacting with an event
- Made text a little less blurry
- Bronze Lance looks more like a lance

BALANCING
- Damage of fist attacks and monster strikes have been reduced and scale differently (a lot less damage to player characters now).
- Adjusted Monster stats, and Bosses are now tougher.
- Feet and Hand slot Light armor has increased Magical Defense
- Light armor now has Physical Defense
- Medium armor's Physical and Magical defense has been increased
- Feet and Hand slot Heavy armor has increased Physical Defense
- Heavy armor now has Magical Defense 

(Changes to equipment are added retroactively to all equipment obtained)

ADDITIONS
- Added FPS Limit Setting in the Options Menu
- Added Fullscreen Mode Setting in the Options Menu (disable to go to Windowed Mode) (EXPERIMENTAL)
